{{Quote|Honor or death.|The announcer|<ref name="SOA" />}}
This '''unknown individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] who served as the announcer for [[blastsword]] duels held on the [[Perator]] of [[Cartann]]'s [[Perator's palace|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Adumar. His job involved performing a set of rituals before the commencement of each duel, as well as coordinating and arranging the matches between fighters, ensuring that any issued challenge was properly received and accepted by its intended opponent.<ref name="SOA" />

During [[Red Flight]]'s&mdash;a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group&mdash;diplomatic visit to Adumar, the perator hosted them in his palace, where the announcer initiated the duels presented as entertainment. He also oversaw the numerous duels that [[Cartann Ground Champion]] [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]] accepted in succession before eventually losing to Lord [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Thanaer ke Sekae]].<ref name="SOA" />
